verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents an API Playground for trying live streaming transcription, which is a first-party interactive, runnable surface. A published OpenAPI spec suggests a structured API reference exists, but nothing shows the reference pages themselves offer try-it or runnable examples across endpoints. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference with per-endpoint runnable examples, Playground coverage beyond live streaming, independent or hands-on corroboration.
